PR04: headless inspector state and bindings

Add the typed headless inspector surface to plate_editor_support:
PlateInspectorState snapshot types, PlateInspectorBinding<T> field
mutations that delegate through PlatePresentationCommands, the
lifecycle-owned PlateLayoutContext.inspector controller bound to the
committed composition, and a hosted inspector controller wired through
the default shell into the default inspector.

- plate_inspector_state.dart: immutable state/binding/section-state
  types, package-internal host controller + resolver sharing the
  default inspector's model resolution, capability layout, visible
  section filtering, and merge rules, plus a standalone command facade.
- plate_presentation_commands.dart: inspector mutation methods
  (geometry, text, shape, line, image, barcode, time, serial, formula,
  emoji, boolean, table) delegating to the existing command controller.
- plate.dart / plate_layout.dart / plate_layout_regions.dart /
  plate_default_editor_shell.dart: hosted inspector binding lifecycle,
  layout-context plumbing, and shell-to-panel wiring.
- plate_default_inspector.dart / plate_default_inspector_panel.dart:
  default inspector renders resolved headless state through the hosted
  binding; binding notifications during the build phase are deferred to
  a post-frame callback to avoid markNeedsBuild-during-build.
- Tests: state (7), binding commands (8), controller lifecycle (5 + 1
  composition-commit regression), model/state parity (8), facade
  delegation (15), default inspector, public boundary, layout legacy
  context.
- Specs: plugin-composition Headless Inspector Boundary; example
  custom-inspector guidance in sdk-example-boundary.

Validation: 102/102 focused tests, dart analyze 0 errors/0 warnings,
just test-flutter and just test-baseline green (SCRATCH
pr-04-focused.log / pr-04-analyze.log / pr-04-full-suites.log).
